title: FedEx Thailand Marks 16 Consecutive Years of AMCHAM Recognition for Driving Long-Term Community Impact
body_markdown:
**Thailand, November 23, 2026** — FedEx Thailand has been recognized by the American Chamber of Commerce (AMCHAM) Thailand with its Corporate Impact Award for the 16th consecutive year, marking a milestone that underscores the company’s sustained commitment to strengthening communities and creating positive social impact across the country.


The achievement places FedEx among AMCHAM’s Platinum-level recipients, a distinction reserved for organizations that have maintained the award for at least 10 consecutive years. The[Corporate Impact Award](https://www.amchamthailand.com/corporate-impact-awards/)


recognizes companies that demonstrate sustained excellence in sustainability, community engagement and responsible business practices while creating long-term economic and social value.


“At FedEx, we believe our responsibility extends beyond connecting businesses and markets to creating opportunities that help people and communities thrive,” said Sasathorn Phaspinyo, managing director, FedEx Thailand. Receiving this recognition of 16 consecutive years is a testament to the passion and dedication of our team members and the strength of our community partnerships. “By investing in education, empowering youth, and supporting local communities, we strive to create meaningful impact by creating opportunities and drive positive change across Thailand.”


Over the years, FedEx has supported initiatives focused on sustainability, economic opportunity and inclusion through its global community engagement program,[FedEx Cares](https://newsroom.fedex.com/fedex-supports-mangrove-conservation-efforts-in-thailand)


.
To learn more about FedEx Thailand, read[here](https://www.fedex.com/en-th/home.html)
